title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Trace copied history through received, durable and replayed progress. Choose read routing from freshness and failure promises, including read-your-write needs, stale reads and log retention.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns native standby controls and measurements.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition; this article owns copied-history progress and read routing.

title: Transactions across partitions
brief: Explain atomic outcomes across partitions, including recovery of a distributed decision after coordinator loss. Distinguish replica agreement from transaction commit and connect invariant scope to the participants that must coordinate.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns CockroachDB intents, transaction records and native error contracts.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Establishes authoritative replicated history, acknowledgement guarantees and losing-quorum availability before this article uses replica agreement.

title: Time, snapshots and distributed reads
brief: Read related partitions at a safe common history. Compare logical timestamps, clock uncertainty and safe historical reads while distinguishing a past observation from authority for a current decision.

neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns single-copy read routing and read-your-write needs.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-reads: Owns native isolation and follower-read choices.

title: Regional placement and survival
brief: Place data and voting replicas against stated latency and survival needs. Derive quorum survival from failure domains and trace the remote coordination introduced by apparently local data and global invariants.

neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns changing membership and placement safely.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-locality: Owns native table-locality and survival settings.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Establishes authoritative replicated history, acknowledgement guarantees and losing-quorum availability before this article uses replica agreement.

title: Rebalancing and cluster change
brief: Move replicas and data while preserving authoritative history. Explain catch-up and safe membership change, and budget rebalancing and decommissioning without treating lost redundancy as spare capacity.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native node removal and health evidence.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-upgrades: Owns binary rollout and finalised cluster version.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Establishes authoritative replicated history, acknowledgement guarantees and losing-quorum availability before this article uses replica agreement.

title: Distributing PostgreSQL work
brief: Choose among native partitions, application shards, Citus and foreign tables from co-location, invariant scope and movement needs. Derive local work, skew and fan-out, then preserve single ownership through a transfer.

neighbouring_ownership.partitioning: Owns native table-pruning and lifecycle concepts.

title: Inside CockroachDB
brief: Trace SQL data through ordered keys, ranges, local storage and replicated ownership. Explain splits, leases and replica agreement with enough detail to see why a hotspot can persist as a cluster grows.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native intents and commit/retry paths.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns SQL/KV/network work and hot-range diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns health, identity and removal procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns transferable replica-agreement concepts; this article develops their native range, Raft and lease application.
